extension.description: A tag-based Markdown journaling tool for easy daily note-taking.
config.title: VS Journal
config.autoSaveMarkdown: If auto-save is enabled, the file will be saved after the specified time (ms). Set to 0 to disable.
config.journalDir.markdownDescription: Directory where journal files are stored. [Click here to select a folder](command:vs-journal.selectJournalDir)
config.enableDateTime.description: Insert date and time into new files.
config.enableDateTime.markdownDescriptio: Automatically insert the current date and time below the heading when creating a new journal entry.
config.systemTags.today.description: Enable or disable the Today system tag in the tag tree.
config.systemTags.today.markdownDescript:
Use this setting to control the visibility of the Today system tag in the tag tree.

Set to true to display Today, false to hide it.
config.confirmDeleteFile.description: Show a confirmation dialog before deleting a file from the tag tree.
config.confirmDeleteFile.markdownDescrip: If enabled, a confirmation dialog will appear before deleting a file from the tag tree. Disable this to delete files without confirmation.
config.confirmDeleteVirtualTag.descripti: Show a confirmation dialog before deleting a virtual tag from the tag tree.
config.confirmDeleteVirtualTag.markdownD: If enabled, a confirmation dialog will appear before deleting a virtual tag from the tag tree. Disable this to delete files without confirmation.
config.virtualTags.caseSensitive.descrip: Match virtual tags with case sensitivity. When disabled, matching ignores letter case.
config.virtualTags.caseSensitive.markdow:
Control whether virtual tag matching is **case-sensitive**.

- **Enabled**: `foo` matches only `foo`
- **Disabled**: `foo` matches `foo`, `Foo`, `FOO`
config.fileNameStyle.description: File name format for new notes.
config.fileNameStyle.markdownDescription:
Controls how file names are generated for new notes.

Examples:
- `datetime-minute`: `2026-05-05-13-45`
- `datetime-hour`: `2026-05-05-13`
- `date-only`: `2026-05-05`
- `compact-datetime`: `20260505-1345`

Only applies to newly created files. Existing files are not affected.
config.folderStructure.description: Folder structure for storing new notes.
config.folderStructure.markdownDescripti:
Controls how folders are created for new notes.

**Examples:**
- `flat`: `note.md`
- `yyyy`: `2026/note.md`
- `yyyy-mm`: `2026/05/note.md`
- `yyyy-mm-dd`: `2026/05/05/note.md`

Only applies to newly created files. Existing files are not affected.
config.folderStructure.flat: Save files directly in the base directory.
config.folderStructure.yearMonth: Group files by year and month (e.g. 2026/05/).
config.folderStructure.yearMonthDay: Group files by year, month, and day (e.g. 2026/05/05/).
config.paste.saveLocation.description: Controls where pasted files and images are stored.
config.paste.saveLocation.markdownDescri:
Determines the storage location for pasted files and images.

- `flat`: Files are saved in the same directory as the note.
- `structured`: Files are saved in a hierarchical folder using the configured folder structure and note file name.

Example (`structured`): `2026/05/07/2026-05-07-13-45/image01.png`

Only applies to newly pasted content.
config.paste.saveLocation.flat: Save pasted files in the same directory as the note.
config.paste.saveLocation.structured: Save pasted files in a hierarchical folder (based on folderStructure and note file name).
